items.limitations: Oracle labels are diagnostic only; reference-point agreement is not latent true-distance coverage.

items.limitations: Error inflation and band omission have mixed effects; target-prior giant performance worsens.

items.requirement: Binary/class/component mode attribution
items.finding: Class, single/binary and parent-kernel mode responsibilities retain weak modes and overlapping attributions.
items.limitations: Responsibilities are conditional model descriptions, not physical binary rates or confirmed stellar classes.

items.limitations: Internal guards pass but the final main evidence gate and new external validation fail; no candidate adoption or post-test retuning.

items.limitations: Local-width/location recovery and minority composition remain inadequate. Source blocks collapse in21 empirical scenarios; the local dust covariance approximation is not exact selection.
